== Additions & Changes ==
* [[Oblivion]] was replaced by the [[Overseer]] for this event, causing [[M-60]] and [[M-60i]] to have no marks on lockers (Reverted)
* [[LAPSE-2]], [[LAPSE-60]], and [[LAPSE-200]] were added.
* [[E-10]] and [[E-60]] were set free, being able to invade [[Section A]], [[Section D]], and [[Section M]] at a 1 in 5000 chance (Reverted)
* all of the entities from the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] have an uncommon chance of invading your run (Reverted)
<br><br><br><br><br><br><br><br>
